title: F1b cavapoos
temperament: 1B Cavapoos are affectionate, playful, and highly intelligent companion dogs that thrive on human connection, blending the gentle, people-pleasing warmth of the Cavalier King Charles Spaniel with the eager-to-please trainability and adaptable energy of the Poodle.
cardDesc: Out of Cakey, our gentle F1 Cavapoo, and Torque, our clever Toy Poodle, this sweet litter of F1B Cavapoo puppies blends affectionate, people-loving warmth with eager-to-please intelligence and low-shedding coats. Raised with daily care and socialization, these adaptable little companions are ready to bring endless joy, cuddles, and playful energy into their new homes.
